title: Cooperative Federalism vs. Aggressive Fiscal Centralization
prelims_pointers: Inter-State Council operates under Article 263 as a recommendatory body.
GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A.
Sarkaria and Punchhi Commissions examined the strengthening of cooperative federalism.

mains_perspective.context: Rising friction between the Union and opposition-ruled states over cess/surcharges, Governor's role, and legislative incursions.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Excessive reliance on cesses dilutes the divisible pool of taxes under the Finance Commission recommendations, starving states of fiscal autonomy.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Institutionalize regular meetings of the Inter-State Council and adhere strictly to Sarkaria Commission guidelines on gubernatorial discretion.

title: Secularism, Uniform Civil Code (UCC) & Constitutional Morality
prelims_pointers: Article 44 directs the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code throughout India.
Freedom of religion under Article 25 is subject to public order, morality, and health.

mains_perspective.context: Balancing the mandate of a unified legal code with the protection of cultural and religious pluralism in a diverse democracy.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: While UCC promotes gender justice and legal uniformity, forced implementation without broad-based consensus can fracture social capital.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Adopt a gradual, consultative reform approach—amending discriminatory practices within personal laws first before pushing for a monolithic code.

title: Inclusive Growth, K-Shaped Recovery & Agrarian Distress
prelims_pointers: MSME sector contributes nearly 30% to India's GDP and 40% to exports.
PM-KISAN provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families.

mains_perspective.context: Macroeconomic GDP growth numbers outpacing wage growth and rural consumption recovery.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: High corporate profitability coexists with stagnant rural wages and high youth unemployment, pointing to structural distortions.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Shift focus from capital-intensive manufacturing subsidies to labor-intensive sectors (textiles, food processing) and climate-resilient agriculture.

title: AI Ethics, Algorithmic Bias & Deepfakes Regulation
prelims_pointers: IndiaAI Mission focuses on computing infrastructure and sovereign AI models.
IT Rules, 2021 mandate social media intermediaries to take down synthetic content within stipulated hours.

mains_perspective.context: Explosive growth of generative AI posing severe threats to electoral integrity, privacy, and national security.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Unchecked algorithmic bias exacerbates social discrimination while deepfakes undermine public trust in democratic institutions.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Enact a robust Digital India Act with mandatory watermarking for synthetic media and algorithmic transparency audits.

title: Bureaucratic Ethics, Lateral Entry & Whistleblower Protection
prelims_pointers: Second ARC 4th Report focuses extensively on ethics in governance.
Whistleblowers Protection Act provides legal mechanisms to safeguard informants against victimization.

mains_perspective.context: Navigating the tension between political executive directives, professional neutrality, and adherence to constitutional conscience.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Anonymity and neutrality are often compromised by systemic political pressure and lack of statutory job security.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement 2nd ARC recommendations: establish Civil Services Boards for transparent postings and operationalize robust whistleblower safeguards.

title: Internal Security Challenges: Left Wing Extremism (LWE) & Nexus
prelims_pointers: Security Related Expenditure (SRE) scheme assists LWE-affected states.
Aspirational Districts Programme targets socio-economic backwardness in LWE corridors.

mains_perspective.context: Geographical shrinking of LWE influence accompanied by challenges in developmental governance in remote pockets.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Kinetic military operations alone cannot resolve an ideological conflict rooted in land alienation and tribal marginalization.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Combine security dominance with aggressive infrastructure push (roads, mobile connectivity) and land rights regularization under FRA, 2006.
